name: Zenryoku de! Kankin & Ryoujoku
source:
A CODE GEASS 2 reaction which of course features our favorite heroines!

The target is the character who loves pizza and the character who can perfectly imitate a cat's meow.

As you progress, you have more and more options to choose from.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034209.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
一部以《Code Geass反叛的鲁路修R2》为题材的作品，当然少不了我们最喜欢的女主角们！

对象是那个爱吃披萨的角色，以及那个能惟妙惟肖地模仿猫叫的角色。

随着游戏推进，可供选择的选项会越来越多。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034209.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
